newsitem.title: USA: PhyMatrix signs Tenet unit as "mall anchor".
newsitem.headline: PhyMatrix signs Tenet unit as "mall anchor".

text.p: PhyMatrix Corp and Tenet South Florida HealthSystem, a unit of Tenet HealthCare, said Friday that they have signed a letter of intent whereby Tenet's Palm Beach Gardens Medical Center becomes the anchor provider at PhyMatrix's Medical Mall at Palm Beach Gardens.

Phymatrix said that through a joint venture, Tenet will manage and operate ambulatory surgery, rehabilitation, cardiac catheterization and diagnostic radiology outpatient medical services in the Medical Mall and that Tenet will lease approximately 55,000 square feet of space.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
